items.headline: U.S. Inflation Slows to 3.4% in July as Gas Prices Decline
items.summary: Official economic data released on Wednesday shows that U.S. annual inflation slowed for a second consecutive month to 3.4% in July, supported by a 2.9% drop in gasoline costs. The easing consumer price index provides relief for households and could reduce pressure on the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates.

items.headline: Total Solar Eclipse Darkens Skies Across Greenland, Iceland, and Spain
items.summary: On August 12, 2026, the year's only total solar eclipse swept across the Northern Hemisphere, plunging parts of Greenland, Iceland, and Spain into daytime darkness. Millions of spectators gathered to watch the rare event while space agencies collected high-altitude data to study the sun's outer atmosphere.

items.headline: Josh Kushner and Bob Iger Agree to Buy Los Angeles Lakers in Record $12.5 Billion Deal
items.summary: Businessmen Josh Kushner and Bob Iger have reached an agreement to acquire a majority stake in the Los Angeles Lakers at a record valuation of $12.5 billion. The deal makes front-page international sports news as the most expensive team purchase in professional sports history.
